Havoc Brothers are effective and resistant, bringing a variety of warriors and monsters to battle, each endowed with unique blessings by the god they follow. When the Founder’s fleet was scattered throughout the Sirius Sector, they faced new dangers in a strange galaxy, and some desperate survivors found new patrons who offered them the chance to adapt, in exchange for their allegiance. The Havoc Brothers embraced the philosophies of their godly masters, carving out a new home for themselves amongst unfamiliar stars. On arriving in the Sirius Sector, the Founder’s fleet was scattered and damaged. Many of these ships and their crews were discounted as destroyed, but had in fact arrived in Sirius far from the rest o... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/havoc-brothers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Havocbound: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, or when it charges, its weapons get AP(+1). ### Special Rules Dangerous Terrain Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Resistance: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Unpredictable: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Furious Aura: This model and its unit get Furious. Havocbound Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Havocbound Boost. Relentless Aura: This model and its unit get Relentless. Resistance Aura: This model and its unit get Resistance. Scout Aura: This model and its unit get Scout. Steadfast Aura: This model and its unit get Steadfast. Versatile Defense Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Defense. Read more ### Spells Cursed Stride (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Havoc Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(2). Dark Assault (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shred in melee once (next time the effect would apply). Havoc Terror (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Havoc Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Havocbound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Havoc Fog (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Shred. ### Units ### Heroes Havoc Destroyer Champion [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 145pts Champion Heavy Rifle(24", A2, AP(1)),
